path.desc: Created by outline-to-path'ing any of the black/brick/indigo hex shapes and retaining only the outermost one.

g.desc: Created by copying the outline layer, stroke-to-path'ing everything, subtracting the black hexagon from the outline and unioning it with the corner lines.
